title: Rule-Based Dialog Management for Voice Assistents in Automotive Environments
central_claims: A unified RDFS-inspired declarative dialog/domain/rule model with a virtual knowledge base can handle contextual automotive dialogs and deploy the same model to Alexa and Google Dialogflow without dialog-specific code.
External knowledge adapters support portability and reuse; highly dynamic vehicle sensor data remains future work.

source_manifest.title: VADiMoS: A Web Tool for Designing Voice Assistant Independent and Ontology Based Dialogs
source_manifest.finding: Original coauthors Ranzenberger and Hacker build browser-based rule editors, test suites, simulation, plugin management and deployment on the 2020 runtime. Shows shop-search example; no independent benchmark or customer deployment evaluation.

research.summary: Full original and 2021 VADiMoS successor read. Same-team reuse enables browser-based tooling and a new dialog instance. Independence, fair comparative advantages, production adoption and later durability remain unresolved.
